intro: Liechtenstein has won more Olympic medals per person than any other country, all of them in skiing.

chapters.title: Skiing
text: Hanni Wenzel won two gold medals at the 1980 Winter Olympics, and Liechtenstein's skiers have won ten Olympic medals in total.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Football is popular, and Liechtenstein clubs play in the Swiss league.

keyTerms.meaning: Divided by the number of people.

items.title: Swiss leagues
items.subtitle: Football
items.text: FC Vaduz play in Swiss football.
